newsitem.title: UK: BFI up 10 as Panamaxes hold firm in quieter market.
newsitem.headline: BFI up 10 as Panamaxes hold firm in quieter market.

text.p: The Baltic Freight Index was up 10 points on Monday at 1,425 points.

Brokers said holidays in the Far East have reduced the volume of fixtures reported but Panamaxes continued firm with reports of period business of three to five and seven to nine months being completed.
Caper and Handy-size business has remained at low levels, they said.
At 1300 GMT BIFFEX was five to 10 points higher and turnover was 137 lots.
